implementation: Dashboard hero shows operations only with operations.read; otherwise orders list only with orders.read; create order only with orders.write. Recent-orders panel shortcut/data require orders.read; existing finance panel remains finance.read-gated.
Recent order IDs remain detail links and are copyable. Shared CommandRecovery shows intent and command codes, with one copy control and polite success/failure status feedback.

Dashboard greeting falls back to “bạn” for blank displayName and preserves long names with wrapping. Known AgentRole.kind enums receive their established Vietnamese label; unknown kinds have an explicit unlabeled state and keep the API code copyable; an empty kind does not get a fabricated name.
The originating ErrorNotice continues to print an unknown command ID; its copy action is centralized in the recovery banner to avoid duplicate same-name buttons.
